string.text:
Lets scripts (squad tactics mods) make an NPC throw a grenade at a point on purpose. The script decides when and where; the engine does the throw.
 
Off = every such request is refused, NPCs only throw when the game itself decides to.
 
Default: on.
Writes one [THROW] line to the log when a scripted grenade throw starts and one when it ends (thrown, refused or failed, with the reason).\n \nDefault: off.
